problem.summary: 传统神经网络结构通常基于线性神经单元（LNU），但生物神经元执行的计算远不止线性求和，这限制了神经网络的计算效率和性能。

motivation.summary: 生物神经元的复杂计算能力表明，更高阶的输入与权重组合可以提升神经网络的性能。因此，需要开发超越线性求和的神经单元。

metadata.abstract: The computational neural-network structures described in the literature are often based on the concept of linear neural units (LNUs). The biological neuron is a complex computing element, which performs more computations than just linear summation. The computational efficiency of the neural network depends on its structure and the training methods employed. Higher-order combinations of inputs and weights will yield higher neural performance. In this paper, a quadratic-neural unit (QNU) has been developed using a novel general matrix form of the quadratic operation. We have used the QNU for realizing different logic circuits.
